mapper.sql: id, kb_id, doc_name, chunk_count, total_chunks, processed_chunks, chunk_ids, status, error_msg, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_knowledge_doc (kb_id, doc_name, chunk_count, total_chunks, processed_chunks, chunk_ids, status) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{docName}, #{chunkCount}, #{totalChunks}, #{processedChunks}, #{chunkIds}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM flow_knowledge_doc WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_knowledge_doc SET status = #{status}, error_msg = COALESCE(#{errorMsg}, ''), chunk_count = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'READY' THEN total_chunks ELSE chunk_count END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_knowledge_doc WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_knowledge_doc SET status = 'FAILED', error_msg = #{errorMsg}, processed_chunks = 0 WHERE status = 'PROCESSING'
